description: This file defines the ServiceEngine class which models the <service-engine> element in the configuration, including parsing and storing various sub-elements like engines, resource loaders, and services.

classes.name: ServiceEngine
classes.description: A class that models the <service-engine> element, providing access to its various configuration components such as engines, services, and resources.

methods.name: getAuthorization
methods.description: Returns the authorization configuration for this service engine.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Engine by its name.

methods.name: getEngines
methods.description: Returns the list of all Engine instances associated with this service engine.

methods.name: getGlobalServices
methods.description: Returns the list of global services.

methods.name: getJmsServiceByName
methods.description: Retrieves a JMS service by its name.

methods.name: getJmsServices
methods.description: Returns the list of JMS services.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service engine.

methods.name: getNotificationGroups
methods.description: Returns the list of notification groups.

methods.name: getResourceLoaders
methods.description: Returns the list of resource loaders.

methods.name: getServiceEcas
methods.description: Returns the list of service ECAs.

methods.name: getServiceGroups
methods.description: Returns the list of service groups.

methods.name: getServiceLocations
methods.description: Returns the list of service locations.

methods.name: getStartupServices
methods.description: Returns the list of startup services.

methods.name: getThreadPool
methods.description: Returns the thread pool used by this service engine.
